knowledge.progressSummary: Discharged the lone sorry in the parent gallery entry Erdos117OQ01.lean (base_implies_behavior) and restored the whole Erdős #117-OQ-01 file family to a fully machine-checked state on Lean 4.26. The sorry sat on a FALSE statement: ExponentialBehavior c was quantified over all ε > 0, but for ε ≥ c the lower base c−ε ≤ 0 and (c−ε)ⁿ at even n can exceed h(n). Corrected the definition to ε ∈ (0,c) and proved the convergence ⇒ exponential-behavior implication via Metric.tendsto_atTop + exp∘log monotonicity. Result: 0 sorries, only the 3 structural axioms (h, h_pos, pyber_bounds), no sorryAx, no Lean.ofReduceBool. | 2026-07-08 (researcher-3): completed Part III's two-sided bracket by adding limSup_le_log_c2, and added convergent_limit_in_pyber_window pinning any limit to [log c₁, log c₂]. Still 0 sorries, 3 structural axioms, 8→10 theorems. | 2026-07-08 (researcher-3): discharged 12 of the 13 Aristotle scaffold sorries in Erdos117OQ01Aristotle.lean (13→1). Routine ones from Mathlib (Tendsto.liminf_eq/limsup_eq, Real.log_pow/log_pos/exp_log, Subadditive.tendsto_lim for Fekete, log-subadditivity of a submultiplicative h). tendsto_implies_exponential_base had the SAME false statement as the main file's old base_implies_behavior (∀ ε>0 fails for ε≥exp L: base exp L−ε≤0, (exp L−ε)ⁿ at even n exceeds h n) — corrected to ε∈(0,exp L) and proved via log-linear comparison. Only liminf_le_limsup left (BoundedAtFilter→IsBoundedUnder conversion). Verified EXIT 0; growth_rate_converges & tendsto_implies axiom-clean (no sorryAx).

Lean 4.26 bit-rot repair of Erdos117OQ01.lean and Erdos117OQ01OQ01.lean (div/le_div iff₀ renames, le_liminf_of_le, two-IsBoundedUnder liminf_le_limsup, log_pow arg order, one_lt_exp_iff)
insights: The 'exponential behavior at base c' notion is only a theorem for ε ∈ (0,c): the lower bound (c−ε)ⁿ ≤ h(n) fails for ε ≥ c because (ε−c)ⁿ at even n outgrows h(n) ≤ c₂ⁿ.
Convergence of log(h n)/n → log c converts to two-sided power bounds via δ = min(log(c+ε)−log c, log c−log(c−ε)) and exp∘log monotonicity (Real.exp_log + Real.exp_le_exp).
Mathlib 4.26: div/le_div/lt_div iff lemmas are now the *_₀ GroupWithZero variants; Filter.liminf_le_limsup takes two IsBoundedUnder (≤ and ≥) args; Real.log_pow has signature (x : ℝ) (n : ℕ).

Aristotle scaffold sorries are mostly one-liners: Filter.Tendsto.liminf_eq/limsup_eq (need [NeBot], atTop ℕ ok), Real.log_pow (args (x:ℝ)(n:ℕ) — NOT (n,x)), Real.log_pos/exp_log, Real.continuous_exp.continuousAt. Fekete = Subadditive.tendsto_lim with BddBelow (range fun n=>a n/n) (bound 0: n=0 term a0/0=0 by simp, n≥1 from hpos).

tendsto_implies_exponential_base (Aristotle scaffold) carried the SAME false-statement bug as the main file's base_implies_behavior: ∀ε>0 is false for ε≥exp L (base≤0, even-power positive spike). Corrected hypothesis ε<exp L; proof: log(exp L−ε)<L, Filter.Tendsto.eventually_lt (const vs growth) gives eventually log(exp L−ε)<log(h n)/n, then lt_div_iff₀ + Real.log_pow + Real.exp_lt_exp/exp_log lifts to (exp L−ε)ⁿ<h n.
eventually c<f x from Tendsto f (𝓝 L), c<L: use Filter.Tendsto.eventually_lt tendsto_const_nhds hconv (hc:c<L) (NOT eventually_gt_of_tendsto_gt, which does not exist in v4.26).
nextSteps: The underlying convergence question for #117 (does lim log(h(n))/n exist? Pyber's c₁<c₂ gap) remains open and is out of scope.
